drafted_from: tool:get-the-judges-ready row in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/tool-rows.json, its code in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ and tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs; the answers were produced by running the tool against a stand-in model server
start_here: Say to your AI: "Get my judges ready: calibrate every rubric in /work/judge/rubrics.json and keep the settled choice in /work/judge/kept.json." It runs calibration and tells you which questions are ready.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads your rubrics file, scores each model on every rubric and writes the choice it settles on to the remember file you name.
instructions: 1. Write /work/judge/rubrics.json with your providers and rubrics (each with calibration cases).
3. Say "Get my judges ready". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs calibrate < /work/judge/request.json.
4. Read result.outcomes: per rubric the model chosen and its scoreboard, or a refused reason. Later tool:ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict calls with the same remember_file ask only the question.

worked_examples.title: Calibrate one rubric and keep the chosen model
worked_examples.ask: Get my judges ready for the claims-done question.
worked_examples.given: From tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs (test "scoreboard and calibrate..."), run for real against a stand-in model server (a bakery's note checker; the stand-in model server answers true only for text containing "trust me"): rubrics.json as in tool:see-which-models-can-judge, request.json {"rubrics_file": "/work/judge/rubrics.json", "remember_file": "/work/judge/kept.json"}. Command: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs calibrate < /work/judge/request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"outcomes": [{"rubric": "claims-done", "chosen": "stand-in", "scoreboard": [{"candidate": "stand-in", "correct": 2, "errors": 0, "passed": true, "needed": 2}], "took_ms": 161}]}}. kept.json now holds one entry (keyed by a blake3 identity of the rubric and models) with chosen "stand-in".
